digest.component_or_area: module-level code organization and size management
propositions: Six files sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC module size cap with minimal headroom remaining, blocking work that requires adding new features to these files
config.py is the highest-churn, highest-centrality module at 93 fan-in and must be relieved to unblock ticket d23e's deprecation alias addition

Extraction of absorbing verbs as plain functions, data-driven tables for flat declarations, and splits on domain seams are the proven refactoring moves to reduce module mass without merely relocating it
New modules created by extraction must exceed 100 LOC anti-fragmentation floor and seam tests must enforce headroom targets to prevent regrowth
The per-function length gate was rejected due to high blast radius; module-level rework plus seam tests are the substitute defense against absorbers regrowing
